# 蒙提霍尔三门问题探索台
n = 300   # 模拟局数

hide()
stay_win = 0
swap_win = 0
i = 0
while i < n:
    car = random(0, 2)
    pick = random(0, 2)
    if pick == car:
        stay_win = stay_win + 1
    else:
        swap_win = swap_win + 1
    i = i + 1
pen_color("orange")
pen_down()
go_to(-130, -100)
go_to(-130, -100 + stay_win * 200 / n)
go_to(-30, -100 + stay_win * 200 / n)
go_to(-30, -100)
go_to(-130, -100)
pen_up()
write("死守不换 " + stay_win + " 局", -130, 60, "orange", 12)
pen_color("green")
pen_down()
go_to(30, -100)
go_to(30, -100 + swap_win * 200 / n)
go_to(130, -100 + swap_win * 200 / n)
go_to(130, -100)
go_to(30, -100)
pen_up()
write("必换 " + swap_win + " 局", 50, 80, "green", 12)
write("不换胜率 " + stay_win * 100 / n + "%，换门胜率 " + swap_win * 100 / n + "%", -170, -135, "red", 12)

# 复利 vs 单利探索台：1000 元存 30 年
rate = 5   # 年利率（%）

hide()
p = 1000
simple = 1000
pen_color("red")
pen_down()
go_to(-200, -100)
year = 0
while year < 30.1:
    go_to(-200 + year * 13, -100 + simple / 1200 * 200)
    year = year + 1
    simple = simple + 1000 * rate / 100
pen_up()
write("单利（红）", 130, -20, "red", 11)
p = 1000
pen_color("blue")
pen_down()
go_to(-200, -100)
year = 0
while year < 30.1:
    go_to(-200 + year * 13, -100 + p / 1200 * 200)
    year = year + 1
    p = p * (1 + rate / 100)
pen_up()
write("复利（蓝）", 130, 120, "blue", 11)
write("利率 " + rate + "%：30 年复利 " + p + " 元", -195, 140, "blue", 12)
write("单利只有 " + simple + " 元", -95, 160, "red", 12)

hide()
m = 2
g = 10
write("总机械能 = " + m * g * h0 + " J", -190, 145, "red", 13)
pen_color("green")

pen_color("blue")
pen_down()

    go_to(-200 + (h0 - h) * 3.5, -120 + m * g * h * 0.02)

pen_down()

# 二元一次方程组探索台：交点即解
s = 10   # 两数之和（x+y=s）
d = 2    # 两数之差（x-y=d）

hide()
x = (s + d) / 2
y = (s - d) / 2
pen_color("blue")
pen_down()
xp = -6
while xp < 6.01:
    go_to(xp * 25, (s - xp) * 25)
    xp = xp + 0.5
pen_up()
write("x+y=" + s, 120, 120, "blue", 12)
pen_color("red")
pen_down()
xp = -6
go_to(xp * 25, (xp - d) * 25)
while xp < 6.01:
    go_to(xp * 25, (xp - d) * 25)
    xp = xp + 0.5
pen_up()
write("x-y=" + d, 120, -120, "red", 12)
pen_color("green")
pen_down()
go_to(x * 25 - 6, y * 25)
go_to(x * 25 + 6, y * 25)
pen_up()
write("解：x=" + x + " y=" + y, x * 25 - 40, y * 25 + 20, "green", 13)
